summary_en: Fujikura Kasei raised the upper limit of its share buyback program from 700,000 shares (2.50% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) to 900,000 shares (3.16% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock), effective from a prior disclosure dated October 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Fujikura Kasei announced a revision to its share buyback authorization on November 4, 2026, increasing the upper limit of shares to be acquired from the previously disclosed 700,000 shares to 900,000 shares. This revision also adjusts the percentage of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) from 2.50% to 3.16%. The company had initially disclosed the buyback authorization on October 30, 2026, and this notice serves to modify specific parameters of that program.
